name: How should I prepare my home before bathroom demolition starts?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before bathroom demolition starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before work begins, remove all personal items from cabinets, closets, and countertops, and establish a clear path for the crew. You should finalize all tile patterns, grout colors, trim choices, and fixture selections so trades have exact specifications on hand. If this is your home's only full bath, plan temporary bathing arrangements during the demolition and plumbing rough-in stages. Clarify designated parking for work vans and coordinate where materials, tools, and debris disposal bins can be safely staged on your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out personal belongings, finalize all tile and fixture selections, plan for alternate bathing facilities, and designate staging space for tools and materials.
